༄༅/ /tshogs zhing dang 'brel ba'i snying po'i nyams len bde ba can du 'gro ba'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshogs zhing dang 'brel ba'i snying po'i nyams len bde ba can du 'gro ba'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos shing dran pas kyang*/ /bde ldan zhing du 'khrid mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /mgon po 'od dpag med la gus btud nas/ /tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs mchog bri/ /'dir rgyal ba 'od dpag med gtso bor byas pa'i tshogs zhing gsol 'debs smon lam bcas rang gi rgyun pa'i nyams len ltar 'chad pa la/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang yang rung min kyang*/ rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal po 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bde ba can la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ mgon po 'od dpag med/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa mched bdun 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang pa la sogs pa nye ba'i sras chen brgyad dang*/ ye shes bla ma 'od kyi tog smon lam blo gros dbang po zhi ba sang sang po'i dbyangs nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi 'jug tu/ oṃ a mi tā bhā sarba gu ru buddha bo dhis sa twa sa pa ri wā ra i hye hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas bzhugs par gyur ba'i dbus su rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba 'od dpag med 'khor bcas/ mdun du sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can 'khor bcas/ g.yas su rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'khor bcas/ g.yon du rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa 'khor bcas/ rgyab du bde gshegs mched bdun 'khor bcas/ steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/

mtha' skor du nye ba'i sras chen brgyad dang ye shes bla ma la sogs pa'i rgyal sras nyan rang yi dam zhi khro bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs dang*/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpa' bo ste/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid pa'i de dpon mchog/mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mtshan thos 'chi ba'i dus byed tshe/ /ma brjed yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi skye ba mchog /'dzin mdzad rin chen gtsug tor can la 'dud/ /mtshan brjod gzungs sngags rgyal po bgrang tsam gyis/ /ngan song sdug bsngal ma lus drung 'byin cing*/ /mngon dga'i zhing du 'khrid mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /zhes dang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa zhes sogs kyis phyag bya'o/ /rgyas par na tshigs bcad rnams 'jogs pa'am de rnams kyi mjug pa 'dir mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs tshar gcig gnyis sogs byed dam min yang*/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan bdun/ de bzhin du/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsu gtor can 'khor dang bcas pa la=/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa= /rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa= /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa mched bdun 'khor bcas sam/ mtshan legs sogs so sor bral nas sam/ mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang sogs tshigs bcad kyis phyag mchod rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/

'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na/ 'phags pa nye ba'i sras chen brgyad dang*/ ye shes bla ma 'od kyi togasmon lam blo gros/ dbang po zhi ba/ sang sang bo'i dbyangs/ nam mkha' mjod la sogs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ yi dam bzhi khro bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum re brjod/ mjug tu me tog dam pa zhes sogs sam/ mchod do/ /phyogs bcu na bdag pos bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab dang bcas pa dang*/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ bdag nyid kyang bran du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /sa gzhi spos kyi sogs dang*/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum sogs gnyis ka'am gang rung gis maṇḍal 'bul/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du mi dge ba bcu dang*/ mtshams me pa lnga dang*/ sdom pa gsum gyi bcas pa 'gal ba sogs sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs ji snyed cig bgyis pa dang*/ khyad par du bde ba can du skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad mthol lo/ /bshags so/ /byang zhing dag pa mdzad du gsol/ rang gzhan skye 'phags thams cad kyis bsags pa'i rnam dkar gyi legs tshogs kun la rjes su yi rang zhing dga' bar bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la'ang dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul lo/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyang mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ 'dir ltar du bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad gzhan kun gyis bskrun pa'i dge ba dang lhan cig

bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba dang bcas te re ltos 'cha' ba'i sems can thams cad kyang gnas skabs ngan song gsum la sogs pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba dang*/ 'di nas shi 'phos ma thag tu bde ba can du mgon po 'od dpag med kyi zhabs drung du padmo las brdzus te skyes nas ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal mngon sum mthong nas chos nyan pa dang*/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par mtshang rgya ba'i rgyur bsngo'o/ de nas slar yang gong gi bla ma dang 'od dpag med sogs la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa de rnams gsol 'debs su bsgyur nas lan bdun nam gsum sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas pa'i 'jug tu/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la sogs pa'i skyabs gnas dam pa khyed rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ khyed rnams kyis bdag cag rnams 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa thams cad las bskyab tu gsol/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed pa de'i tshe gnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba dang*/ zhal mngon sum bstan nas bde ba can du 'gro ba'i lam sna mdzad du gsol/ de'i tshe rgyal ba 'od dpag med rgyal sras brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong zhing dad gus shugs drag dang bcas te dga' bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byas nas bde ba can gyi zhing du theg pa chen po'i rigs can dbang po rnon po sems can gyi don sgrub pa la mthu thogs pa med pa can du gyur cig de nas snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis phyin nas sems can rnams la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham pa'i chos bstan te rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam bzang rnam par dag pa la rim gyis 'khrid nas sangs kyi sa la 'god par gyur cig go 'phar mchog ma thob pa'i skye ba thams cad du'ang rtag tu dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi'i lus rnam par dag pa thob cing tshe rabs dran pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas tshul khrims kyi phung po mthar phyin par byed nus par gyur cig

/skye ba thams cad du yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang 'phrad nas des bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos thams cad thos bsam sgom gsum gyis grub pa mthar phyin par byed nus par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du rgyal ba kun gyi mdo sngags kyi dam pa'i chos ma lus pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du bzung nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan thogs par gyur cig tshe rabs kun du'ang rgyal ba sras bcas rnams dang mi 'bral zhing*/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed par gyur cig de'i tshe gzungs sbobs ting 'dzin mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs yon tan thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thob cing 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po ji 'dra ba de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi don byas nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig slar yang*/ rgyal ba 'od dpag med la sogs pa'i skyabs dam pa khyed rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ zhes ci 'grub brjod/ skyabs gnas thams cad kyi sku'i cha nas 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun byung nas rang gi spyi bo snying ka la sogs pa'i lus kyi cha thams cad nas zhugs pas sgo gsum gyi nyes pa'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ de nas skyabs gnas gzhan thams cad rgyal ba 'od dpag med la thim par gyur/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rgyal ba 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /thugs rje bzung du gsol/ bdag gi snying kar 'bral ba med par bzhugs la byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ zhes ci 'grub dang*/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mgon po 'od dpag med de nyid rang gi spyi bor byon te tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs snying kar rang gi sems dang dbyer med du bzhugs par gyur/ de nas grub na 'dod dpag med kyi snying po dang gzungs ring bzla/

skabs 'dir spyi bor bzhugs te 'pho ba'i dmigs skor byas kyang legs /gang byed kyang mjug tu/ nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba na/ zhes sogs dang*/ bar do'i snang ba shar ba gyur ma thagaces sogs dang*/ shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /zhes sogs dang*/ rgyas bar na bzang spyod dang*/ bsdu na/ kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul zhes pa nas/ sems can rnams la phan pa mang bgyid shog /ces pa'i bar lta bu ci rigs bya'o/ /༈ zhar byung la 'pho ba'i skabs su gong gi gsol 'debs rnams bya bar 'dod na sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs gnyis las/ dang po'i skabs su yan lag bdun pa byas rjes/ 'od dpag med/ rin chen gtsug tor can/ mi 'khrugs pa/ sangs rgyas sman kyi bla ma sogs bde gshegs bdun phyogs gcig dang*/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang nye ba'i sras chen brgyad sogs rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dang*/ de nas dngos brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang dkon mchog rin po che rnams la gsol 'debs lan gsum re byas pa'i 'jug tu/ skyabs gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis tshe 'das 'di nyid la byin gyis rlobs shig rjes su bzung zhig 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob cig 'di nas shi 'phos ma thag tu bde ba can du drongs shig gam/ 'dren par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs bya/ dngos gzhi'i skabs tshe 'das kyi spyi bor 'od dpag med bskyed nas yan lag bdun pa mdor bsdus byed dam ma byas kyang*/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rgyal ba 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes lan nyer gcig sogs brjod pa'i rjes su/ de dang sbyar nas/ zab lam 'pho ba thebs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'das 'di nas shi 'phos gyur ma thag /khyod kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /bde ba can du nges par drang du gsol/

/zhes lan 'ga' re brjod pa skabs dang bstun cing*/ gzhan thun mong du/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam sna tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'itshogs rnams dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs so/ / zab lam= /tshe 'das 'di nas= khyed rnams thugs rje'i 'od zer= /bde ba can du nges par= /zhes lan bdun nas gsum lta bu ci rigs bya'o/ /gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus ci ltar byed pa ni rang gi 'dod pa yin pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges mtshon tsam mo/ /tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong ba'i tshul mang yang*/ /bde ba can du skye ba'i thabs gtsor byas/ /snying po'i gnad kun bsdus nas brjod pa 'di/ /don gnyer can gyis bskul bzhin bdag gis bris/ /ces pa 'di yang dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i rgyan 'jed sngags ram pa grags pa 'od zer sogs gur yags ri khrod pa 'ga' res thugs dam du mdzad 'dod nas bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas co ne'i dgon nyid du lhag bsam dag pas sbyar ba ste/ gzhan dag la yang phan thogs par gyur cig /par du sgrub pa po yang bskul ba po rnams so// maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/tshogs zhing dang 'brel ba'i snying po'i nyams len bde ba can du 'gro ba'i lam bzang bzhugs/ -PAGE 192--PAGE 191--PAGE 185-
